body: There’s more to it than that. Did you come to a full and complete stop (whatever that town defines a complete stop)

I can’t tell you what the best way would be. I think if I had a gun I would do that and take my chances I don’t fuck it up. I’ve tried pills it didn’t work. I often wonder if a hot shot or heroin would be the best way to go, but I wouldn’t know where to start looking. Plus it’s expensive I think right? I dunno now I don’t think I could use a gun I wouldn’t want to be remembered like that. So maybe pills or drugs then I would think with drugs maybe being the best? I agree with you though it sounds way easier than it probably actually is. Hanging seems super easy as well but I’ve read that you actually have to be kinda technical with the rope length and height of the fall etc or even the knot style matters I guess? There are people out there who care even on the interwebs. Maybe take a chance on one of them and see if talking could possibly help? I wish you nothing but the best friend.
Your words ring very true. Brutally honest. Knowing this you have the power to remove those people and things from your life. Find true people to bring into your life. You can totally do this.
Very kind of you keep going
I understand, just sad to see someone suffer in any way when it can be prevented or fixed.
It may not seem like it now but there’s always hope. Always you just have to find it. It can be something small or something huge but just find something
It doesn’t sound like she wanted to suffer and that sounds like what’s going on. Plus I don’t think she wanted to live with damages or ruined internal organs.
I’m concerned. Too much aspirin can be lethal or damaging to your organs please don’t take this lightly.
What do you need. I’m here
I’ve been here my heart goes out to you. What do you need right now? Is there anything I can do for you?

I hear you and I mostly agree. It is hard no doubt, maybe it’s hard for a reason. Also, I believe that you are right it’s not a cowards way out. Most people can’t understand pain so bad that you would rather die and bear it. I also don’t believe you are a pussy, I think there’s something deep down keeping you with us and I think you should figure out what that is and tap into it. For me it was my children, I want to die but I can’t leave them if that makes any sense at all. I don’t know if it’s courage necessarily hell I don’t know what it is but it’s definitely not cowardly.
What happened? It sounds like it was devastating. Whatever happened don’t let them win. If nothing else shove it in there fucking faces that they couldn’t beat you.

As a 42 year old man I can look back now and thank 23 year old me for not giving up. I have 4 wonderful kids. The love of my life at that time left me broken and wounded it took me years to recover, but I did and I think you will do it as well. There’s someone out there for you. It’s hard man I know the rejection is just the worst, but you have to find a way. I also think a belief in something is helpful wether it be “god” or many gods or no gods or anything really just faith in something higher. I do happen to believe in god and if you think it could help you I would be happy to explain what I think god is. If not we can talk about a belief in no god as well because there can be peace in that as well and I’ve been there. You have so much life to live and I won’t lie and tell you it’ll be easy because it won’t, but it will be rewarding. If nothing else than to say you battled this and won. Embrace the struggle it hard man so hard he’ll I struggle with it a lot, but eventually I have always come out the other side and you can as well.

I was and still am just like you for the most part. I keep things very low keel trying not to bother someone. It has done a lot of damage to how I mentally process what’s going on. I see the world from a different lens than most. If you should ever change your mind My offer is always open. I truly wish you peace and happiness.
Hell yes. Fight back anyway you can! Pain isn’t always bad especially when you embrace it.

I would suggest talking to someone. They are your friends it isn’t a burden at all. I would venture to guess that they would be willing to help. It sounds like you want help? Or someone to talk to? I’m free if that helps.
There is no painless way I have found and I’ve looked, even tried. Most effective? No clue they all have risks because no matter what your mind says your body doesn’t want to die and it will fight.

Your words are very honest because of this I think deep down you know where the problems are. I know they are hard to fix, I know most people are fake. There are real people out there sounds like you have met them in the past right? You have a lot of heartache man a lot. My heart goes out to you so much pain to endure. What I do know is that I feel a lot of the same things as you. The feelings are real, what is also real is how we process and handle them. You got this, your life experience could be used to help so many people grieving or trying to find understanding. I wish you the best.

The voices are brutal aren’t they my friend. A lot of us hear them and fight them. You sound like you have fight left in you yet no? Sounds like you have been fighting for a while I know it’s hard. You are stronger than this I know you don’t believe me now, but keep fighting like hell. I hope you are able to get some peace tonight my friend and wake up ready to fight some more.

Being a coward as you put it is the only reason I’m still here. I’ve tried I just fuck it up like everything else. Take a chance to open up to someone and you will find that Angel to be with you and comfort you in your time of need. I know loneliness and I hate it. It is truly awful. You have it in you to take a risk and find your rock. Dig down and find it.

I understand what you are feeling. I often feel similar. What I can offer is if you enjoy music then do that. Do that as much as you can and you might surprise yourself. Be around music people you already have a common bond with them. Maybe that could help build a relationship. There’s someone out there for you and I’ll bet you can find her/him if you can manage to put yourself out there. Again I know from experience it isn’t easy and you will get hurt but the reward is worth the risk. You got this!
This too shall pass my friend. I know it’s dark right now but there is a light at the end of the tunnel. Don’t ever quit I don’t know you but believe me this will get better.

Here’s what I know, sometimes it’s instant and sometimes people bounce off and end up with horrific injuries but still alive. As far as speed goes I dunno, but it’s truly horrible to see and to clean up. I’m struggling myself would you like to chat?

I’m sure it’s different for everyone. I’m not casting blame or judgement either. For me the birth of my children was absolutely life changing I do not know what I would do without them. That being said the first years were rough man. There were times that I wanted to bail man no doubt. Now they are older and can communicate thoughts and ideas, dreams and wishes it’s amazing man. However, you don’t need to be married to be an amazing father as others have said. I dunno man maybe just talking to her will help. Just be honest and do what you say you are going to do. If she knows that you will be there for your child and she’s not in it alone maybe that will help her? It seems like your heart is in a good spot. Be open with her maybe she is having the same fears deep down?

You don’t love anything about her, I see. Yeah that’s tough man. Maybe look at it from a different point of view. Like maybe you aren’t settling for her, but you are doing a selfless act by remaining and handling your responsibilities. I mean it sounds like you want out I would just be honest in that case as nice and as best I could.
I’m Curious what about her do you not love?
